key.name: menubar-enabled
key.summary: Turn the top bar into a macOS menu bar

key.name: hide-distro-menu-button
key.summary: Hide the distribution's menu button (such as Zorin Menu) from the top bar
key.description: The Super key keeps opening it.

key.name: menubar-app-menus
key.summary: Show the focused app's own menus in the menu bar
key.description: File, Edit, View and the rest, for apps that share their menus (GTK apps with a menu bar, LibreOffice).

key.name: menubar-all-monitors
key.summary: Show the menu bar on every monitor
key.description: Off shows it on the primary monitor only.

key.name: dock-enabled
key.summary: Show the macOS dock at the bottom of the screen
key.description: Replaces the overview's dash. Turn off Dash to Dock while it is on.

key.name: dock-all-monitors
key.summary: Show the dock on every monitor
key.description: Off shows it on the primary monitor only.

key.name: dock-icon-size
key.summary: Size of the dock's icons, in pixels

key.name: dock-autohide
key.summary: Hide the dock when a window covers it
key.description: Move the pointer to the bottom edge of the screen to bring it back.

key.name: dock-magnification
key.summary: Magnify dock icons under the pointer

key.name: dock-genie
key.summary: Minimize windows into the dock with the genie effect
key.description: Replaces GNOME's minimize animation. Turn off Magic Lamp while it is on.

key.name: launchpad-enabled
key.summary: Show Launchpad from the dock's Apps icon
key.description: A full-screen grid of every app.

key.name: launchpad-super-key
key.summary: The Super key opens Launchpad
key.description: Instead of the overview or the distribution's app menu.

key.name: spotlight-enabled
key.summary: Search apps, files and settings with Spotlight

key.name: spotlight-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that opens Spotlight

key.name: control-center-enabled
key.summary: Show quick settings as the macOS Control Center
key.description: Toggles first, then titled sliders, a Focus toggle and Macr's look.

key.name: app-icon-tiles
key.summary: Give app icons the icon theme lacks a macOS tile
key.description: The original icon on a light macOS squircle, in the dock, Launchpad, Spotlight and the app switcher.

key.name: osd-enabled
key.summary: Show volume and brightness as a macOS pill
key.description: GNOME's on-screen display moves under the menu bar at the top right, as a small frosted pill.

key.name: switcher-enabled
key.summary: Show Alt+Tab as the macOS app switcher
key.description: A frosted panel with big icons, a soft highlight and the chosen app's name. Alt+Tab keeps working as before.

key.name: notifications-enabled
key.summary: Show notifications the macOS way
key.description: Banners as frosted cards at the top right, and the clock's calendar and notification list as the macOS Notification Center.

key.name: mission-control-enabled
key.summary: Show the overview as macOS Mission Control
key.description: Windows spread over the dimmed wallpaper, with the Spaces bar always at the top.

key.name: hot-corners-enabled
key.summary: Use macOS hot corners
key.description: Each screen corner can open Mission Control, Launchpad, the desktop or the Notification Center, or lock the screen. Takes over GNOME's own hot corner.

key.name: hot-corner-top-left
key.summary: What the top left corner does
key.description: none, mission-control, launchpad, desktop, notification-center or lock-screen.

key.name: hot-corner-top-right
key.summary: What the top right corner does
key.description: none, mission-control, launchpad, desktop, notification-center or lock-screen.

key.name: hot-corner-bottom-left
key.summary: What the bottom left corner does
key.description: none, mission-control, launchpad, desktop, notification-center or lock-screen.

key.name: hot-corner-bottom-right
key.summary: What the bottom right corner does
key.description: none, mission-control, launchpad, desktop, notification-center or lock-screen.

key.name: window-corners-enabled
key.summary: Round window corners the macOS way
key.description: Windows that do not round their own corners (Qt, Electron, X11 apps) get rounded corners, and frameless ones a shadow.

key.name: window-corner-radius
key.summary: Window corner radius
key.description: In pixels.
